substantive_difference: Old Plane378 five red intervals compare3 long units across DC against2 long units on only the lower portion of AD, omitting the top strip. New design colors FULL AD including the strip, distinguishes numerator/denominator by two hues, and introduces a specific central tile long/short source pair. The error is component-to-composite similarity, not omission of the top strip. Related Plane436 r41 counts3 versus4 ordered boundary spans; this design neither numbers nor alternates boundary spans and adds no unmatched fourth span. It does not retarget the old incidental E or B finals.
new_feature_and_misconception: Transfer the small tile aspect b/a directly to the full frame AD/DC by matching vertical-short and horizontal-long roles. This wrongly assumes similarity of the component and the composite, giving2/3 (D), although the true full-frame ratio is8/9 (A).
